g.text: Governance, risk and compliance platform — Processes and Capabilities
One system, every process that uses it and in what role, and the capabilities those processes support. This shows the business impact of changing the system. A long list against a low
criticality rating is worth a second look.

g.title: Scan code and dependencies for security defects
Analyze complaint signal for conduct risk
Grant or decline an architecture exception
Evaluate and select a technology or platform
Maintain cardholder data scope and evidence
Manage issue and remediation to closure
